title: Chapter 127 Goblin Chamber Of Commerce
content:
Chapter 127 Goblin Chamber Of Commerce

Before Gong Zhe asked this question, he had not actually received authorization from his clan to establish a branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce in Mengchong City. It was still his personal idea.

But he was confident that he could get the authorization from the clan to establish a branch here, otherwise he would not say it directly.

During the afternoon's break in the transaction with the alliance lord, he had reported the situation here to the clan through the goblin clan's special information transmission channel. Samples of the Zerg energy coins were also sent to the nearest goblin chamber of commerce branch.

After all the transactions were completed, he uploaded an updated report and explained his thoughts.

If nothing unexpected happens, Gong Zhe's original life trajectory is to continue to lead the current caravan on business trips. When enough capital is accumulated, he will expand the caravan and continue to travel for business.

This is the destined fate of these low-level businessmen. They will continue to work until one day they are unable to do what they want and can no longer work, then they will retire and return to the clan to take care of themselves.

This is still an ideal state. The caravan keeps walking in the dangerous wilderness and will encounter various accidents, such as special strange attacks, attacks from the evil god camp, plots by local races, plundering by rogue bandits, etc. , if they don't handle it well, their lives will come to an end.

Gong Zhe is now lucky enough to have an opportunity to change his destiny, so he will seize it firmly!

After careful analysis, Gong Zhe believed that he applied to create a new branch here and recommended himself as the head of the branch, mainly responsible for the transaction of high-purity energy coins. There is a high probability that this matter will be approved by the clan.

When the people within the clan learned that he had discovered a high-purity energy coin, they would definitely attach great importance to it. At the first moment, the clan would want to discuss technical cooperation with the Zerg.

But we learned from the lords of the alliance that this high-purity energy coin was rewarded by the power behind the Zerg. Who owns the specific production technology? Are the Zerg willing to cooperate? These are all questions.

The most important thing is that many super powerful powers are subject to various restrictions by the rules of this world. Just because they can come up with these things does not mean that they can create these things in this world.

The goblin clan is very aware of this, so this road is difficult to follow.

In the end, we could only settle for the next best thing, and find a way to intercept all the energy coins flowing out of the Zerg. Use them for research reference, or directly use them for your own use, which are all of extremely high value.

If the Zerg can provide a sufficient amount of high-purity energy coins, the goblins will achieve huge breakthroughs in many aspects of research and manufacturing, and the strength of the entire goblins will be even greater!

The tribe will definitely send a dedicated high-level person to take charge of this matter. As a high-level person, it is impossible for him to stay here and be in charge of a small branch. It is not difficult for Gong Zhe to recommend himself as the person in charge of the branch because of his contribution to the discovery of high-purity energy coins.

The goblin clan is very united, and conflicts with each other are relatively rare.

…

At the dinner, Meng, Hu Wei and other alliance lords all looked at the Zerg hosts present. It could be seen from their expectant expressions that they really wanted the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to establish a branch in Alliance City, but in the end this matter The decision-making power still lies in Wu Qing's hands.

Seeing this situation, Gong Zhe had a better understanding of the status of the mysterious lord and the Zerg who did not appear.

He didn't know that the host was conveying Wu Qing's opinions directly, and thought that just one clansman sent by the Zerg could make a decision on behalf of the entire alliance. If this was the case, it would highlight the status of the Zerg in the independent territory alliance.

The lords of the alliance will not disclose the fact that the Zerg host has the ability to communicate remotely.

"We agree that the Goblin Chamber of Commerce will establish a branch in Mengchong City!"

Everyone has been waiting for the host’s affirmative answer, which is a happy result for everyone!

"Haha! I have to call you President Gong Zhe from now on?"

"As long as your Chamber of Commerce branch is established! We will definitely spend all the Zerg energy coins in your Chamber of Commerce!"

Meng was also a very thoughtful person. He figured out all the links in an instant and had already changed his mind to call Gong Zhe the president.

Everyone also knows the purpose of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. Without the high-purity energy coins of the Zerg, it would be impossible for them to establish a branch in a remote place like Alliance City.

The establishment of a chamber of commerce branch requires consideration of many factors, which not only consumes a large amount of resources, but also disrupts the existing layout of the chamber of commerce in this area.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce made an exception for the Zerg Energy Coin. As a member of the alliance, everyone is very proud!

"The Zerg are the big backer behind the alliance!"

When the Zerg came up with something, it attracted the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to establish a branch, which further proved the power of the Zerg.

"Lord Fierce, it's too early to call me the president. The formal decision to establish a branch still needs to wait for notification from the clan!"

"My caravan will not leave for the next few days, so we can make some preparations here in advance!"

"The establishment of the branch still needs the strong support of all the lords here!"

Gong Zhe is now familiar with almost all the lords of the alliance, and his speech has become more casual.

"You have established a branch in Mengchong City. It will be more convenient for us to purchase things in the future. We will definitely purchase more and strongly support your business!"

"You also need to bring more good things here to open our eyes!"

"..."

Everyone was talking about the branch in Mengchong City.

…

The dinner was over and the sun had not yet set.

The lords of the alliance returned to the heavily guarded Mengzhong City. Because there were many lords of the alliance staying in the city, and a large number of personnel and materials just purchased were stored, Wu Qing strengthened the defense of Mengzhong City and sent more Zerg dogs to garrison.

Gong Zhe asked people to pack up, and he drove a goblin guardian himself. Under the escort of several goblin guardians, he walked around nearby. He wanted to choose a favorable venue for the branch.

The current city scale of Mengzhong City is not large, and the city certainly cannot be used as a branch station, so the only location can be selected within the lord's protection range outside the city.

Fortunately, the lord's protection range of this Mengzhong City is very large. Gong Zhe ran around and took a fancy to several places.

As night fell, Gong Zhe returned to the caravan camp and entered his special goblin transport vehicle. While busying the caravan affairs, he patiently waited for news from the tribe.

…

Most of the alliance lords who returned to Mengzhong City were still excited. Today, they not only purchased goods that far exceeded their expectations, but also witnessed the launch of Zerg energy coins, and will soon witness the birth of the first chamber of commerce branch in this area!

Seeing everyone in this state, Meng pulled everyone together, continued to drink and eat meat, and imagined the future. This can be regarded as a team-building activity of the alliance.

"Now, even the largest goblin chamber of commerce is going to build a branch here! Everyone must seize this opportunity to develop the territory well!"

"Of course! Let's work together to build a good alliance!"

"The army of my territory is always ready! Waiting for the call of the alliance to recover the lost land!"

"With the Zerg energy coins and a large amount of military supplies, everyone's military strength can take a big step forward! Everyone must seize the time and improve the military strength!"

"..."

The alliance lords' mentality has also changed from forming an alliance for self-protection to the current aggressiveness.
